setupHints.text: Requires dsh 0.2 or later. The command-line tool (`npm install -g skill-healthcheck`) shares the same journal in `~/.skill-healthcheck/`.
件页安装，或运行 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-skill-healthcheck`。需要 dsh 0.2 及以上。命令行工具（`npm install -g skill-healthcheck`）和插件共用 `~/.skill-healthcheck/` 里的同一份记录。
